parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A primary left-click button made of ABS plastic, located on the top front of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: Used for primary selection and clicking actions in computer operations.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A right-click button made of ABS plastic, positioned adjacent to the left button.
parts.Functional_description: Used for secondary actions such as context menus and additional commands.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A side button made of ABS plastic, typically located on the left side of the mouse.
parts.Functional_description: Used for forward navigation or custom programmable functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns via a small spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A side button made of ABS plastic, typically located below the previous side button.
parts.Functional_description: Used for backward navigation or custom programmable functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns via a small spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A DPI adjustment button made of ABS plastic, located near the scroll wheel.
parts.Functional_description: Used to change the sensitivity or DPI settings of the mouse.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a small spring.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: An additional programmable button made of ABS plastic, possibly located on the top or side.
parts.Functional_description: Used for custom functions or macros depending on user configuration.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or inward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A scroll wheel made of rubber with a plastic core, located between the left and right buttons.
parts.Functional_description: Used for scrolling through pages and can also act as a middle-click button.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis for scrolling and can be pressed vertically for clicking.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the mouse made of ABS plastic, housing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and ergonomic shape for user comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the internal components but moves as a whole across a surface.
